text: oversized-hoodie: an oversized, drop-shoulder pullover hoodie with a relaxed, boxy silhouette worn loose. Also called: baggy hoodie, big hoodie, drop-shoulder hoodie.
boxy-tee: a boxy-fit t-shirt with a squared-off, non-tapered silhouette. Also called: boxy t-shirt, box-fit tee, straight-cut tee.
cropped-zip-up: a cropped zip-up jacket or track top that ends at or above the waist. Also called: crop zip jacket, cropped track jacket.
graphic-print: a t-shirt or top featuring a graphic or printed design - logos, illustrations, statement text. Also called: graphic tee, printed tee, statement tee.
ribbed-tank: a ribbed-knit tank top, fitted and sleeveless. Also called: rib tank, ribbed cami.
low-rise: jeans or pants that sit below the natural waistline. Also called: low-waist denim, hip-huggers.
cargo-pant: pants with multiple utility pockets, typically loose-fit. Also called: cargo jeans, utility pants.
baggy: loose, relaxed-fit jeans with excess fabric through the leg. Also called: baggy jeans, loose-fit denim.
wide-leg: jeans with a wide, non-tapered leg opening from hip to hem. Also called: wide-leg denim, flare-adjacent jeans.
raw-hem: jeans with an unfinished, frayed hem edge instead of a stitched hem. Also called: raw-hem denim, frayed-hem jeans.
bike-short: fitted, stretch shorts that end mid-thigh, athletic-inspired. Also called: cycling shorts.
tech-jogger: performance-fabric jogger pants with tapered ankle cuffs. Also called: tech pants, jogger sweatpants.
crop-top: a short top that ends above the waist, athletic or casual. Also called: cropped top, midriff top.
track-pant: straight or tapered athletic pants, often with side stripes. Also called: track bottoms, athletic pants.
co-ord-set: a matching top-and-bottom set sold or worn as one coordinated outfit. Also called: co-ord, matching set, two-piece set.
multi-pocket-jacket: a jacket with multiple functional pockets, utility-inspired. Also called: cargo jacket, utility jacket.
techwear-shell: a technical, weatherproof shell jacket with a utilitarian techwear aesthetic. Also called: tech shell, techwear jacket.
quilted: a quilted, padded jacket with a stitched diamond or channel pattern. Also called: quilted jacket, puffer-adjacent jacket.
oversized-parka: a long, oversized parka-style coat, often with a hood. Also called: parka, oversized coat.
boxy-jacket: a jacket with a boxy, squared-off silhouette rather than a fitted cut. Also called: boxy coat, cropped boxy jacket.
